description: Set up a routine: a question RoBot answers again by itself, on a schedule (“every morning at 8: how did my games and their rivals do?”) or when something happens (a trigger), with a note to the person’s notifications (and Discord or email if connected). Use it for “every morning”, “each Monday”, “keep me posted”, “tell me when”, “alert me if”. Each run is RoBot answering, on the person’s RoBot usage. Actions: create (name, question, and every or trigger_sql), update (id, and only what changes), pause, resume, delete, restore, run (once now), list. question is asked whole on each run: name the games and what to compare. Times are New York’s. Opens with RoBot: an account RoBot isn’t open on yet gets not_available.

at.description: The time of day in New York as HH:MM (24-hour), for day and week; default 08:00

check_every_minutes.description: For a trigger: how often it’s checked, 5 to 1440 (default 15)

cooldown_hours.description: For a trigger: the least time between its runs, 0.25 to 168 (default 6)

every.description: How often, for a routine on a schedule

id.description: The routine’s id (from create or list), for every action but create and list

max_fires_per_day.description: For a trigger: the most runs in a New York day, 1 to 24 (default 3)

name.description: A short name in plain words, like "Morning check-in"

question.description: What RoBot is asked on each run, whole and on its own

trigger_sql.description: For a trigger: one read-only SQL query over RoTerminal’s research tables, a row for each thing that has happened, its first column that thing’s key, newest first, LIMIT 50 at most

name: routine
title: Alerts and routines
